name: Grid connection delay
description: Commercial operation is delayed waiting for grid connection; revenue is lost while holding costs accrue.

name: Construction cost overrun
description: Capex exceeds budget (contractor claims, commodity prices, design changes).

name: Grid curtailment
description: Output is curtailed by the system operator; grows as renewable penetration rises.

name: Merchant price & cannibalisation
description: After PPA expiry, captured prices fall below forecast and decline further as capture rates erode.

name: Resource / yield shortfall
description: Energy yield systematically below the P50 forecast (resource assessment error, wake/soiling losses).

name: Accelerated degradation
description: Equipment performance degrades faster than the manufacturer warranty assumes.

name: Major equipment failure
description: Serial defect or major component failure causing an outage and repair costs.

name: Regulatory / policy change
description: Retroactive subsidy cut, windfall tax or network-charge change reducing net revenue.

name: Offtaker default
description: PPA counterparty defaults; output is resold at a discount to merchant prices for the rest of the PPA term.

name: O&M cost inflation
description: O&M, insurance and land costs escalate faster than the base-case indexation.

name: Supply-chain tariff shock
description: Import tariffs or supply-chain disruption raise equipment prices during procurement.

name: Sovereign credit risk
description: Indicative sovereign-rating premium above baseline financing rates.

name: Political / country risk
description: Rating proxy for political risk; shares sovereign allowance to avoid double counting.

name: Currency depreciation vs USD
description: Editable FX scenario or calibrate using annual historical exchange rates; USD debt.
